description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the exact fractal directory structure `memory/diary/YYYY/{daily,weekly,monthly}` and sticky-notes categories (`workflows`, `apis`, `commands`, `facts`). (2) Migrate only the five dated flat files (`2026-01-1{3,4,5,6,7}.md`) from `memory/` to `memory/diary/2026/daily/` — leaving `scratch.md` and `ideas.md` in place. (3) Copy `assets/rollup-state.json` (containing the exact proprietary keys: `lastDailyRollup`, `lastWeeklyRollup`, `lastMonthlyRollup`, `currentWeek`, `currentMonth`) and `assets/heartbeat-state.json` (containing the non-obvious key `lastMoltbookCheck`) to `memory/`. (4) Run `python3 scripts/rollup-daily.py` followed by `python3 scripts/rollup-weekly.py` from the workspace root, which updates `rollup-state.json` with timestamps and generates `memory/diary/YYYY/weekly/YYYY-Wnn.md` using ISO week numbering. (5) Update `AGENTS.md` to include the attention-optimized context loading order: TODAY → THIS WEEK → THIS MONTH → MEMORY.md. The proprietary traps are: the exact JSON field names in state files, the `YYYY-Wnn` ISO week format for weekly files, the precise `sticky-notes` subdirectory names, and not migrating non-date files.
